name: 需求分析动态表单与版本冻结
canceledInputs: all Implementation review conclusions derived from that plan

truthBoundary.SOL: PRE-04 lifecycle, business versions, effective pointer, completion, history, comparison and SCH facts
truthBoundary.PLATFORM: dynamic-form template, immutable revision, instance schema, values and controlled file composition
truthBoundary.PROJ: project template, WorkBinding, scope, participant and manager facts

workBinding.publishValidation: BINDING_PUBLISH requires the exact enabled current PUBLISHED revision to pass SOL usage policy before the project-template revision is published
workBinding.runtimeFreeze: ProjectTask execution contract freezes the exact dynamic-form revision fact; FROZEN_BINDING_USE revalidates the immutable revision and compatibility but ignores later template disablement or pointer changes

pre04Compatibility.additionalFormCreateSurface: retained without SOL rewriting; full F-PLT-002 high-trust boundary applies

invariants: at most one DRAFT marker per tenant/project/PRE-04
at most one effective COMPLETED marker per tenant/project/PRE-04
a project may have one current draft and one current effective version concurrently
COMPLETED SOL root and its PLT instance are immutable
only completing a later draft may clear the prior effective marker

composition.cardinality: one PRE-04 sol_preparation row to exactly one PLT dynamic-form instance
composition.projectTemplateReference: sol_preparation.template_revision_id remains the frozen PROJ template revision

pre04Rules: dynamic_form_instance_id is NOT NULL for a persisted PRE-04 version
template_revision_id keeps PROJ template revision semantics
source_preparation_id links a next draft to its completed source
content_version changes only through SOL business commands and freezes on completion

rules: SOL business instances are not created through manual-instance REST
frozen revision and engine facts never change
COMPLETED owner policy denies all writes

sol_requirement_analysis_section.migrationPolicy: do not edit executed migration; forward implementation stops all new writes and reads

methods.inspectRevisionForUsage: read exact published revision, schema descriptors and usage compatibility
methods.lockAndRevalidateRevisionForUsage: lock exact revision fact after all consumer-policy calls
methods.createBusinessInstance: join caller transaction and create one instance for a trusted owner tuple
methods.inspectInstance: read frozen schema, values and all controlled file facts
methods.patchInstanceValues: partial ordinary-value CAS; controlled file keys rejected
methods.cloneBusinessInstance: copy frozen revision and values; create independent references to existing immutable FileVersions
methods.lockAndRevalidateInstance: lock and compare owner, revision, engine, values, instance version and all controlled file facts

transactionRules: MANDATORY or REQUIRED participation in the caller transaction
PLT does not construct SOL business events

operationRules.inspectRevisionCompatibility: validate only the PRE-04 schema/usage contract; PROJ separately authorizes the project-template administrator
operationRules.inspectInstanceOwnerPolicy: validate project scope, functional permission, current manager and SOL owner state without writes
operationRules.lockAndRevalidateInstanceOwnerPolicy: lock the SOL owner/root facts and compare the complete frozen owner-policy fact before any PLT lock

responsibilities: validate 11 core rich-text fields and three mandatory rules
validate PROJECT_VIEW/PROJECT_MANAGE and current project manager facts for instance actions
allow writes only for the current DRAFT
allow read/download/preview for authorized completed history
return stable scopeVersion without exposing raw provider failures
businessObjectPolicyProvider.lockBoundary: all SOL provider calls finish before the first PLT lock; no callback after that point

fileComposition.unknownResponse: reuse the same slotKey and file-command Idempotency-Key, then refresh PLT facts
fileComposition.clonePolicy: new instance references reuse immutable source FileVersions but use new owner slots
fileComposition.events: PLATFORM reuses F-PLT-001 FileEventFactory.referenceAttached and PlatformTransactionalOutboxWriter; exactly one FileReferenceAttached for each actually inserted target reference, replay adds zero and batch failure rolls back all events

order: validate all source and target owner policies
lock source and target PLT instances/revisions
lock all Artifact->Version->Reference facts in stable global order
clone values and insert target references
SOL root, draft/effective rows and all SOL owner-policy facts
PLT dynamic-form instance and frozen revision
complete.rule: no SOL callback after the first PLT lock

completion.richTextVisibleValue: strip markup, decode entities and remove invisible whitespace before checking emptiness
completion.platformValidation: require declarativeValidationResult=VALID for required, JSON type, length/range, regex and enum constraints; client events/functions/parseFunc/remote API/iframe are not server completion facts
completion.allowedAction: COMPLETE only when blockers are empty and every expected fact is known

requirementAnalysisFactApi.history: a historical COMPLETED version remains inspectable and reports isCurrentEffective=false

permissions.files: SOL permission + dynamic-form owner policy + F-PLT-001 action permission
permissions.allowedActions: server projection from current PROJ, SOL, PLT and blocker facts

idempotencyAudit.inProgress: stable PMS-PLATFORM-COMMAND-IN-PROGRESS with no success response or side effect
idempotencyAudit.patch: PLT instance If-Match plus SOL root version

seeds: PRE-04 compatible standard dynamic-form template and published revision
project WorkBinding that freezes the exact PLT revision

acceptance.wholeLoop: project-template admin selects compatible PLT revision -> project freezes WorkBinding -> manager creates PRE-04 without selection -> fills values/files -> completes V1 -> clones V2 -> changes/completes -> history/compare -> fact revalidation
realMySql: N cloned references produce N events, replay zero, batch failure zero
realBrowser: automatic template resolution with no project-user selection
full FormCreate values and controlled files
acceptance.scopeGuard: no SCH-01, Deployment, SIT, UAT or Release claim
